If you jack up a Brutalizer with more combat ‘ware, drugs, and firepower, you get flesh machines that’ll take heavy power tools to put a crack in. Hence, Jackhammers.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Animals).

Weapons:

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

The Testera is an improved version of the Igla, a shotgun that has a target market of combat forces on a budget. This Rostović product has only one function: it goes boom. Boom each barrel at a time or both together. Sometimes a powerful blast of simplicity is all you need in a narrow alley or hallway. Don't stress about aiming when the Testera's wide spread is there to guarantee you a hit.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: EQ Shotgun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Short Barrel Shotgun

Damage: 3d6/5d6 • Capacity: 2 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. Can only load Shotgun Shells. When firing this weapon, the user may choose to expend an additional round. When done, this weapon deals 2d6 additional damage (5d6).

Range: Short Barrel Shotgun
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell

Foundry notes:

  • Listed damage is 3d6/5d6; the sheet uses the first value.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Cost Per Dose: 100eb (Premium)

Is it a refreshment? A dietary supplement? A drug? Does it matter? Open up a can of AssKick, and try our new fruit flavor - purple!

⋙ PRIMARY EFFECT ⋘

  • Lasts 4 Hours.
  • For the duration of the primary effect, the first damage the user suffers (after armor) in a Round is reduced by 1, or by 2 if the user also suffered a Critical Injury as part of taking the damage.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, the user’s COOL and TECH are reduced by 2 (Minimum 1).
  • The user feels ‘amped up’ and ‘ready to kick ass’ as if they lack a fear response. Do your best to roleplay accordingly.

⋙ SECONDARY EFFECT (DV17) ⋘

  • If the user wasn’t addicted to Asskick, they are now. While addicted, the user suffers a -2 penalty to Checks made with the following Skills unless they are currently experiencing the Primary Effect of AssKick: Athletics, Concentration, Endurance, Perception, Stealth, and Tactics.

Cost: 100eb (Premium) per dose
Type: Street Drug

Foundry notes:

  • While addicted, switch on the "AssKick Addiction" effect.
  • When an addicted character doses, use "AssKick Addicted Primary" instead of the normal primary effect; it cancels the withdrawal penalties for the duration.
  • Stat and skill changes are automated; caps, minimums, durations, and everything else are not.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Street Drugs).

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2
Increase Body by 2 (and related stats). Stacks. Max at 10 Body.
